scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
I'm an engineer that specializes in adding Slots to normal Weapons and Armor.
My service fee, the required materials and the chance of success all depend on the specific item I'm working on.

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Adding Slots may seem simple, but it's far more complicated than it looks.
If you're interested in my service, let me know.

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
You want to add a Slot to a weapon?
I categorize weapons by their difficulty in adding a Slot, C Class being easiest and S Class the most difficult.
Which class would you like to try?

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
C Class, eh?
Now, I can only upgrade certain equipment in that class, so please choose one of the following items, so we can try to add a Slot to it.

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
B Class?
Alright, this is the average equipment category.
Please choose the weapon to which you'd like me to try to add a Slot.

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Ooh, A Class.
This is some high risk territory!
Alright, which weapon would you like me to try adding a Slot?

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa...
S class? Alright...
It'd be a near miracle if I can actually pull this off.
Okay... Which weapon shall we try adding a Slot to?

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Armor, you said?
Sure, no problem.
Armor is divided into 4 different classes, depending on the work difficulty.
C Class is the easiest one, and S Class he hardest one.
Which class would you like to try?

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
C Class Armor, eh?
Sounds reasonable.
Which armor would you like to try adding a Slot?

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
You have chosen average B Class.
So, what kind of armor do you have?

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Ooh, A Class.
This is some high risk territory!
Alright, which armor would you like me to try adding a Slot?

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Um... S Class?
You sure about this?
Alright... Let me know the Armor to which you'd like to add a Slot, and I'll tell what I need to try it.

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Well, I haven't really refined the art of Slot Addition.
It's so complicated that I'd be lying if I told you that I knew every factor that affected the process.
Still, I do notice a few trends...

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
In some towns, Slot addition attempts are more successful for equipment with fewer upgrades.
In other towns, the opposite is true.
isn't that really peculiar?

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Oh, there's also something really important that you should know.
If you ask me to add a Slot to something, make sure that you don't have multiples of it in your inventory.

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Here's an example: if you have a +7 Manteau and a normal Manteau in your inventory, then I will randomly pick one of them for my Slot Addition attempt.
Just remember to be careful.

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Again, ^FF0000only carry one of the equipment to which you want me to add a Slot^000000.
All other equipment with the same name should be placed in your Kafra Storage, got it?

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Take it easy, adventurer.
If you ever want to try adding a Slot to some of your equipment, come back and let me know.
Seeya~

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
You want to add a Slot to a {0}?
Alright, please bring me ^FF0000{1} {2}{3}^000000, {4}and my ^FF0000{5},000 zeny^000000 service fee.
Ah, and don't forget to bring that {6}!

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
I can try to add a slot now if you have the required items and zeny.
However, you should know that there's a chance that I might fail.
Therefore, I need to give you a fair warning...

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
If you have all the required materials, my zeny service fee and the Armor, then we can go ahead with the Slot Addition attempt.
But before that, I must warn you of the risk.

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
If this attempt to add a Slot to your Weapon fails, then the ^FF0000Weapon^000000, ^FF0000and any Cards compounded to it will be destroyed^000000.
Do you still want to try to add a Slot?

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
If this attempt to add a Slot to your Armor fails, then the ^FF0000Armor^000000, ^FF0000it's upgrades^000000 ^FF0000and any Cards compounded to it will be destroyed^000000.
Do you still want to try to add a Slot?

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Alright then, let the work begin!
You'd better pray for a successful result.

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Great, it seems to be successful.
It looks pretty well done. Congratulations!

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Wah! ...I am so sorry, it failed.
However, I am completely innocent.
This is your luck, and it is destined by god, okay?
Don't be so disappointed, and try next time.

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text: I wish you good luck next time!

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
I'd like to go ahead with this Slot Addition attempt, but you're missing a few things.
You sure that you have the equipment, required materials and the zeny?

scripts.speaker: Seiyablem
scripts.text:
Need some time to think about it, huh?
Alright, I can understand.
Just remember that life's no fun if you're always playing it safe~

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
I'm considering becoming a Slotting Engineer.
It's a new field where you can add Slots to equipment, and it'd be cool if I can work in such a lucrative career.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
There's a huge element of luck involved in successfully adding Slots from what I can understand.
You fail sometimes, but if you're super lucky, you can add two Slots.
Crazy. Huh?

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
But don't get too excited.
Only certain equipment can handle the addition of two extra Slots.
There's so much more I have to learn before I can even be an apprentice...
